Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
From a discussion in the discord, the below question came up;

During a referendum, which of the below are subject to and relevant for sequencing/impulse and would move the impulse back to the acting vampire?
a) burning the edge for a vote
b) burning/discarding a political action card for a vote
c) using an effect from a card in play
d) playing a card for its effect
e) casting votes gained from one´s vampires (normally from their title)

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
I think the point is more that the impulse/sequencing rule isn't really being actively applied during referendums (opposite to e.g. combat) when the players actually must wait till they get the impulse before they can do any of a) to d) and as soon as they do the impulse goes back to the active player.

I haven´t come up with a scenario where it would actually matter but that doesn´t mean there isn't one.

Messages.Author: KoRneeshon
Messages.Body:
Casting votes should stay as it is. You shouldn't be forced to declare how you vote (or abstain) just because it's your turn around the table - you decide to cast votes (or not) in reaction to the current vote balance and ongoing table negotiations. This is politics.

It might be a bit messy but only if more players are sure how they want to vote and that they want to vote immediately - but that's just "human" issue, game mechanics are unaffected, you can vote all at once.
